description: For a drop's creator, once it sold out, graduated or its window closed: record the reveal seed on chain so anyone can check the item order against the commitment fixed at launch. Optional — MomoSwap publishes the art when the sale ends either way. Signs a login message, then the reveal transaction. Requires a signer: COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY locally, or in external-signer mode this returns `needs_signature` for the user's wallet to sign (see submit_signed_tx).

collection.description: the drop's collection mint (or any of its items' mints)

loginSignature.description: external-signer mode only: the wallet's signature over the login `message` a previous call returned as needs_signature { kind: 'message' }

name: reveal_nft_drop
title: Reveal an NFT drop
